name: description-list
title: Description List
description: Read-only facts: `DescriptionList` over `PropertyRow`s, each a label, a value, an optional hint under the value and an optional action beside it. A `<dl>` of `<dt>`/`<dd>` groups on the web, `role="list"` on device; `layout="inline"` puts labels beside values and wraps to stacked when narrow.
